name: Swiss International
description: International Typographic Style rooted in mathematical precision, objective clarity, asymmetric grid alignment, and purposeful white space.
designPrinciples: Objective presentation of information without decorative distraction
Prominent asymmetrical hierarchy anchored by generous whitespace
Vivid crimson accent punctuating a disciplined neutral substrate

guidelines: Rigid typographic scale with clear size step-downs
Tight, deliberate line heights (1.1 for display titles, 1.4 for captions)

layout.structure: Rigid multi-column flex alignment with uniform module gaps
layout.alignment: Consistent left flush baseline alignment across disparate modules
rules: Dedicate at least 40% of the canvas surface to intentional negative space
Use thin 1px horizontal division lines in #E2E8F0 to delineate content zones
Highlight primary numbers or key callouts in vivid crimson #E11D48

patternsToAvoid: Centered title and body text blocks
